data.translation: Dado Ferdo: We would get them from Salim of the Khoja family; he used to sell spools of silk. We would get them. And that Sareke of the Shuviko family, er, we would get threads like these things, like little skeins, we would measure them out; those were thick ones. That is, we had learned embroidery with them. First we learned with those and then we learned with silk, sheets, whatever you wanted. We would make covers, zambarishat, we would embroider zambarishat, we would embroider pillowcases, tablecloths...
